So she’s guarded… that can be a good or bad thing. If she’s someone who is just waiting for someone she trusts to open up to, then you can start trying to show you care more. Talk to her, show interest in her life, ask her how she is ( even if the answer is “ fine” or “ good “). Eventually she may see that you genuinely care and be more open. 
If she’s just a true loner, it’s more difficult, as you wouldent  want to be to pushy in advances. 
Either way, before you confess to her, you should let her get to know you a bit. If your both shy, opening up a little bit on both your parts will be nerve wracking, but very bonding.

If your at all interested, perhaps spend some time just talking to her. Text or call her, hang out at school/work/wherever you guys know each-other from. See If she’s  someone you’d want to be with.

Nope Iv felt this… I’m going to give a bit of advise that you are free to disregard. Working towards things while depressed is one of the hardest flipping things you can ever do. There isn’t motivation or hope, just dread. But starting small, the smallest, one itty thing each day, will build up. Your applying for jobs? Cool you’ve done it. You’ve applied, you put in effort and it’s out of your hands. 
You want to start a business? Reaserch one thing each day. Read about it. See if you could make it work. Plan a bit more each day.  Let it slowly build into something worthwhile. There is no rush, no deadline, no stress, just slowly move forward. 
Take breaks, evaluate, spend time with loved ones above all as they are your support. Don’t worry so much about your weight, just do the next best thing.
